title: myosotis palustris subsp. laxiflora
intro: Myosotis palustris subsp. laxiflora, commonly known as marsh forget-me-not, is a subspecies of the forget-me-not plant (Myosotis palustris) that is native to Europe. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Myosotis palustris subsp. laxiflora include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to ease coughs and soothe irritated tissues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
